desc:
✈️ Build your own airport and turn it into an international hub!

Start with a small terminal and a single gate, then create the airport tycoon of your dreams, one floor at a time.

🏗️ Build check-in desks, security lanes, gates, shops, restaurants, lounges, and monorails!
🛫 Draw runways and taxiways, then watch planes land, park at your gates and take off
🌍 Open routes to real cities and fill your passport with stamps
🛩️ Fly your own planes straight from your gates
✏️ Create your own airline with a custom name, colors and livery

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game to keep up with new updates!
